name: Bazel ROCm
display_title: Keep the non-sampled dimensions in jax.random.choice when no samples are drawn

head_commit.message:
Keep the non-sampled dimensions in jax.random.choice when no samples are drawn

When shape has zero elements, choice returned jnp.zeros(shape), dropping
every dimension of the input except the sampling axis. For a (3, 4) array
with shape=(0,) and axis=1 it returned shape (0,) instead of (3, 0), unlike
numpy.random.Generator.choice and unlike the non-empty path.

Compute the output shape once and use it for both the early return and the
final reshape.

Fixes #42429.

name: Bazel ROCm
display_title: Serialize and execute the exported SavedModel on CPU in jax2tf_multiprocess_test when a separate libtpu.so plugin is dynamically loaded.

head_commit.message:
Serialize and execute the exported SavedModel on CPU in jax2tf_multiprocess_test when a separate libtpu.so plugin is dynamically loaded.

When JAX dynamically loads a separate libtpu.so plugin, the statically linked TensorFlow TPU runtime in the same process cannot share the TPU devices already opened by libtpu.so. Gating CPU SavedModel serialization and execution on the dynamic libtpu environment variables avoids a conflicting second TPU initialization in process 0 while keeping standard TPU execution unchanged.

PiperOrigin-RevId: 1016625771
